messages.content: Can we do all of it?

All four 18+ feature groups have been implemented, wired into the UI, and verified with unit tests. Everything is saved.

---

### 1. 🎯 "Strict 18+ Only" Mode & Built-In 18+ Source Presets
* **3-State 18+ Feed Mode (`off` | `mixed` | `strict`):**
  * Added [`normalizeNsfwMode`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L156-L162), [`getEffectiveNsfwMode`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L164-L169), and [`setNsfwFeedMode`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L171-L216) in [app.js](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js).
  * Updated [`fetchRandomFromSource`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L939-L1150) and [`getRandomEnabledSource`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L920-L937) so `strict` mode filters exclusively for `over_18` / `nsfw` items (`nsfw=1` on Reddit, `over_18` post filtering, and RedGIFs/18+ Tube fallback), while `mixed` allows both SFW and 18+ and `off` blocks all 18+ content.
* **Auto-Unlock 18+ Source Pack:**
  * Added [`ADULT_PRESET_SOURCES`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L62-L70) (`RedGIFs Trending 18+`, `18+ Tube Viral`, `Reddit NSFW Viral`, `RedGIFs Top Clips`, `Free 18+ Clips`) and [`syncAdultPresetSources`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L218-L246) to automatically unlock presets when 18+ is enabled and hide them when 18+ is turned off.
  * Added a custom **18+ Source** checkbox (`#newSourceNsfwCheck`) and **Load Built-In 18+ Source Pack** button (`#loadAdultPresetsBtn`) in [index.html](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/index.html#L230-L240).
* **1-Tap 18+ Category Chips:**
  * Added [`ADULT_QUICK_CHIPS`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L72-L81) and [`renderNsfwQuickChips`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L1868-L1925) for instant 1-tap category switching on both the **Player** (`#nsfwQuickChipsBar`) and **Search** (`#searchNsfwChipsBar`) tabs whenever 18+ mode is active.

---

### 2. 🚀 RedGIFs Direct `.MP4` Resolver & Expanded 18+ Tube Filters
* **RedGIFs API v2 HD `.MP4` Extractor:**
  * Added [`extractRedgifsId`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L482-L497), [`getRedgifsAuthToken`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L499-L517), [`resolveRedgifsUrlToMp4`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L519-L547), and [`searchRedgifsVideos`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L549-L597) in [app.js](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js).
  * Automatically resolves `redgifs.com/watch/...` and `redgifs.com/ifr/...` links found on Reddit, Lemmy, or the Webpage Scanner directly into playable HD `.mp4` streams, plus added a dedicated **RedGIFs 18+** engine pill (`#engRedgifs`) in [index.html](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/index.html#L140-L143).
* **Duration & Quality Filtering for 18+ Tubes:**
  * Added [`filterAndSortTubeResults`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L599-L638) and wired `#tubeDurationSelect` (`All`, `< 1 min`, `1–5 min`, `5+ min`) and `#tubeQualitySelect` (`All`, `HD 720p+ Only`) into [`searchFreeTubeSites`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L640-L759).

---

### 3. 🔒 Hidden 18+ Vault, Safe-Mode Scrubbing & PIN / Biometric Lock
* **Hidden 18+ Vault:**
  * Videos saved while 18+ mode is active or from 18+ sources are tagged with `isNsfw: true` via [`isItemNsfw`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L248-L263).
  * [`filterVaultItemsForDisplay`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L265-L275) and [`renderVault`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L1664-L1764) automatically hide 18+ saved videos whenever 18+ mode is `off` and display a discreet unlock banner (`#vaultHiddenNotice`) and filter selector (`#vaultFilterSelect`).
* **Instant Safe-Mode Scrubbing:**
  * [`scrubNsfwFromActiveSession`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L277-L315) immediately unloads any active 18+ video from the player, purges 18+ items from `videoQueue` and `lastSearchResults`, and hides 18+ Vault items and preset sources when switching to Safe Mode (`off`).
* **4-Digit PIN & iOS FaceID / TouchID (WebAuthn) Lock:**
  * Added [`hashPinCode`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L334-L343), [`setNsfwPin`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L345-L355), [`verifyNsfwPin`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L357-L364), [`clearNsfwPin`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L366-L370), [`registerNsfwBiometric`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L372-L407), and [`authenticateNsfwBiometric`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L409-L433), gated inside the age/lock modal (`#ageGateModal`).

---

### 4. 🕵️‍♂️ iPhone Privacy & Discreet Playback Controls
* **Auto-Mute in 18+ Mode:** [`shouldAutoMuteItem`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L455-L459) automatically mutes 18+ streams on load when `settings.autoMuteNsfw` is enabled (`#autoMuteNsfwToggle`).
* **Auto-Lock When Backgrounded:** [`handleVisibilityAutoLock`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L435-L444) listens to `visibilitychange` and `pagehide` to automatically lock 18+ mode and scrub the active session when you switch apps or lock your iPhone.
* **1-Tap Panic / "Boss Key" Gesture:** [`triggerPanicSafeMode`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L317-L332) is triggered via the header **🛡️ Safe** button (`#panicSafeBtn`) or by **triple-tapping the top header bar** (`#appHeader`), immediately muting/pausing playback, scrubbing all 18+ content, and returning to the Player tab.
* **Discreet Filenames on Save:** [`buildExportFilename`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L461-L480) generates generic filenames (`reelvault-clip-XXXX.mp4`) when exporting or sharing 18+ clips to the iOS Files/Photos sheet.

---

### 🧪 Verification
* Added 14 unit tests in [tests/adult-suite.test.js](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/tests/adult-suite.test.js) alongside [tests/app.test.js](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/tests/app.test.js) and [tests/new-features.test.js](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/tests/new-features.test.js) — **all 93 tests across 33 test suites pass**.
Can we remove auto lock when background and replace it with pick up the video you were watching right where you left off?

We've removed **Auto-Lock When Backgrounded** and replaced it with **Resume Video Where You Left Off**. Everything is saved.

### What Changed
1. **Removed Auto-Lock on Background & Added Resume Setting ([index.html](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/index.html#L470-L479)):**
   * Replaced `#autoLockOnHideToggle` with **Resume Video Where You Left Off** (`#resumePlaybackToggle`, enabled by default).
   * Backgrounding the app, switching Safari tabs, or locking your iPhone no longer turns off 18+ mode or scrubs your active video.

2. **Persistent Video & Timestamp Resume ([app.js](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L1281-L1433)):**
   * [`savePlaybackState`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L1326-L1369) continuously saves your active video, queue, and exact playback timestamp (`currentTime`) to `localStorage` (`STORAGE_KEYS.PLAYBACK_STATE`) on `timeupdate`, `pause`, `pagehide`, `visibilitychange`, and when navigating between Prev/Next videos.
   * [`restorePlaybackState`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L1371-L1419) and [`handleVisibilityPlaybackChange`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L1422-L1443) automatically reload your active video and seek `#mainVideo` to the exact second you were watching ([`getSavedPlaybackTime`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L1300-L1324)) inside [`updatePlayerUI`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L2803-L2840) when you return to or reopen the app.
   * When a video finishes (`ended`), its saved timestamp resets to `0` so replaying it later starts fresh.

3. **Unit Tests Updated ([tests/adult-suite.test.js](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/tests/adult-suite.test.js#L456-L499)):**
   * Updated the test suite to verify that backgrounding the app preserves 18+ mode, saves the exact playback position, and restores the video right where you left off upon returning — **all 93 unit tests pass**.
